messages:
maria_cs: FYI Satori Health opened a severity-2 ticket — their internal search rerank is returning worse results after yesterday's model/quantization update. They measured precision@5 down ~18% on their test prompts. Asking for product triage.
oliver_se: Can you paste a minimal example from their eval set and the before/after outputs? Also which model id we rolled? @anita_ml any known regressions from the runtime side?
maria_cs: Quick paste: 
```
query: 'patient discharge summary best-practices for heart failure'
before_top3: ["docA", "docB", "docC"]
after_top3: ["docX", "docY", "docZ"]
metrics: precision@5 before=0.72 after=0.59 (per Satori harness)
```
They said it started immediately after deploy at 2024-06-14 03:12 UTC. Customer provided support bundle: eval set + logs (link: <s3://satori-bundles/abc123>)
anita_ml: Thanks. We rolled `llama2-chat-q8_2024-06` to reduce inference cost. Short version: quantization can change embedding geometry and downstream reranker behavior. Need to confirm if embeddings differ or reranker model is unstable to small shifts.
devin_pm: Severity and prioritization: this is affecting a paying enterprise under a paid plan. SLO worries. Propose: 1) immediate mitigation: enable fallback to previous float model for that customer route; 2) short-term (1 week): run differential embedding evaluation across random samples; 3) medium-term (2-4 weeks): add regression tests and per-customer canary thresholds. Thoughts?
sarah_account: Satori is threatening to pause ingest for a new cohort unless we fix or rollback. Revenue risk flagged. Please mark high priority.
anita_ml: I can run a quick check tonight: compute cosine distribution diff between float and q8 embeddings for their eval set. If distribution shift > 0.05 KL-ish we should rollback for them and create a safe rollout guard.
maria_cs: Customer asked for ETA within 24h. They want a mitigation so their search doesn't degrade for their users.
oliver_se: For immediate action: ops, can we route Satori traffic to `model:llama2-chat-fp16` for their org-id until we validate? @deploy_bot can you confirm what we can do without infra change?
deploy_bot: deploy-bot: rolled `llama2-chat-q8_2024-06` to region us-west-2 at 2024-06-14T03:12Z. Can toggle routing per-customer via feature-flag `route_override` (requires config deploy, low-risk). Estimated 30m to enable for a single org.
devin_pm: Decision: enable `route_override` for org satori-001 as a stopgap (owner: eng-platform). Create product ticket for embedding/regression work with acceptance criteria: 1) identify cause (quantization vs reranker sensitivity) 2) automated regression gate preventing >5% precision@5 drop on customer eval sets 3) rollout policy that can auto-fallback per-org. Tag: P1. Owner: anita_ml + eng-platform.
anita_ml: I'll attach the quick diff results here when done. If we see systematic drift across >10% of queries we escalate to rollback.
maria_cs: Created INC ticket: INC-20240614-57 and product ticket: PROD-4532 (link: <redwood.atlassian.com/PROD-4532>). Noting customer SLA and revenue owner @sarah_account.
oliver_se: For backlog/roadmap ask: devin, please add PROD-4532 to the next roadmap sync. Rough estimate: spike (2w) + implement (4w) for regression harness + per-org rollout. If accepted into next cycle, we can harden rollout controls and reduce future breakage.
devin_pm: Adding to roadmap candidates. For prioritization board: label `customer-impact:high`, `area:embeddings`, `mitigation:rollback-capability`. We'll discuss tradeoffs in roadmap meeting. Thanks all.
notes: thread created for intake -> product triage; contains root message + replies in chronological order
